title: Shakshuka
author: Claude
description: Eggs poached in a smoky pepper and tomato sauce. Bring bread for the pan.
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and fry for a minute, then add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. Season.
Make four hollows, crack an egg into each, cover and cook until the whites are set (5–7 minutes).
Scatter over the feta and serve from the pan.
